name: raws-color-picker
title: HSV Color Picker
blurb: HSV color picker with saturation panel, hue slider, and hex input.
description: A full-featured color picker with an HSV color selection panel, continuous hue slider, direct hex input, copy button, and optional eyedropper tool.
use_when: Building design tools or color editors where precise HSV selection and eyedropper support are needed.
avoid_when: When simple hex or RGB inputs suffice or when touch support is limited.
a11y: Color selection uses mouse/touch events, buttons have sr-only labels, hex input has pattern validation.
